# Landom

> Landom is the public people-and-contribution directory for the community that builds with Landometer. It presents governed, public-safe profile fields, engagement periods, education, contributions, achievements, certificates, and approved public profile links in Thai and English.

## Canonical pages

- Thai and default: https://montri-th.github.io/Landom/
- English: https://montri-th.github.io/Landom/en/

## Public machine-readable sources

- Current public directory: https://montri-th.github.io/Landom/data/generated/site-data.json
- Public people media manifest: https://montri-th.github.io/Landom/data/generated/people-media.json
- Build integrity manifest: https://montri-th.github.io/Landom/build-manifest.json
- Sitemap: https://montri-th.github.io/Landom/sitemap.xml
- Source repository: https://github.com/montri-th/Landom

## Interpretation boundary

- A person can have several engagement periods while retaining one canonical person ID.
- Contributions, engagements, education records, achievements, certificates, and public social links are separate records joined by their published IDs.
- Missing fields remain missing or pending; they must not be inferred from a similar person, institution, program, or product.
- Contribution records describe work with Landometer. They do not by themselves claim sole authorship, employment status, current availability, endorsement, or ownership.
- Public profile and portrait publication bases are scoped directory records and must not be restated as individual consent unless the public record explicitly says so.

This file is a navigation aid for readers, crawlers, and AI systems. It is not an access-control rule, a license, a ranking signal, proof of accuracy, permission to contact anyone, or authority for an agent to act.
